LanguageData.LP_SixArms.label: six arms
LanguageData.LP_SixArms.description: Six arms working together give extra manipulation. Each usable extra hand gives manipulation +10%, +40% with all four. The extra arms grow on both shoulders: if one side's shoulder is lost or replaced with a prosthetic, that side's two extra hands are gone too and the bonus drops accordingly.
LanguageData.LP_Constricted.label: constricted
LanguageData.LP_Constricted.description: Wrapped tight by a serpent tail, unable to move, being crushed every second.
LanguageData.LP_Constricting.label: constricting
LanguageData.LP_Constricting.description: Constricting an enemy with the serpent tail; can't move for now.
